## Overview

This directory contains TOGAF-aligned architecture guidance for the **Security Operations** domain at Gainwell Technologies. It follows the Architecture Content Framework (ACF) pattern established in the AI Security domain and covers the architecture from Phase A strategic vision through Phase D Component ABBs.

page_texts.3:
[strategy/guidance/security/SecOps/README.md#what-this-is--is-not]

## What This Is / Is Not

**This content IS**:
- Normative architecture guidance (SHALL/SHOULD/MAY per RFC 2119)
- Vendor- and solution-agnostic — describing *what* capability is needed architecturally
- Structured following TOGAF ADM Phases A through D

**This content IS NOT**:
- Security standards or enforceable control baselines → see `standards/security/`
- Vendor runbooks, SOC playbooks, or implementation guides
- Solution Building Blocks (SBBs) — those are Phase E–F outputs

[strategy/guidance/security/SecOps/README.md#guid-numbering-scheme]

## GUID Numbering Scheme

```
GUID-SEC-SECOPS-<TYPE>-<LEVEL>.<DOMAIN>.<SEQ>

LEVEL   DOMAIN   PURPOSE
0       *        Vision, Capability Map, Capability Descriptions
1       *        Composite ABB
2       1–7      Component ABBs (one per L2 capability area)
3       1–7      Reference Architecture Documents (paired with Component ABBs)
```

| Level | Type Segment | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Phase A | `VISION` | `GUID-SEC-SECOPS-VISION-0.1.01` |
| Phase A–B | `CAP-MAP`, `CAP-DESC` | `GUID-SEC-SECOPS-CAP-MAP-0.1.02` |
| Phase B–D Composite | `ABB` | `GUID-SEC-SECOPS-ABB-1.1.02` |
| Phase B–D Component | Domain shortcode (`MON`, `CTI`, `IR`, `VULN`, `SOAR`, `FORENSICS`, `ANALYTICS`) | `GUID-SEC-SECOPS-MON-2.1.01` |
| Phase C–D RAD | Domain shortcode + `RAD` | `GUID-SEC-SECOPS-MON-RAD-3.1.01` |

[strategy/guidance/security/SecOps/README.md#recommended-reading-order]

## Recommended Reading Order

1. **[Architecture Vision](GUID-SEC-SECOPS-VISION-0.1.01.md)** — understand the business context, problem statement, and strategic intent before any other document
2. **[Capability Map](GUID-SEC-SECOPS-CAP-MAP-0.1.02.md)** — understand the L1/L2 capability structure
3. **[Capability Descriptions](GUID-SEC-SECOPS-CAP-DESC-0.1.03.md)** — deeper narrative on each L2 capability area
4. **[Composite ABB](GUID-SEC-SECOPS-ABB-1.1.02.md)** — architectural reference connecting the capability model to the Component ABBs
5. **[ABB Matrix](GUID-SEC-SECOPS-ABB-MATRIX-2.1.08.md)** — traceability reference for all ABBs
6. **Component ABBs** (5–11 above) — read the specific Component ABB for the capability you are designing
